mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 81 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, though the humidity makes it feel like 90. The moon is in its Third Quarter phase, and if you are up early, the space station will be visible tomorrow at 4:24 AM, appearing near Cross Plains and traveling toward the Oregon and Fitchburg area. Tonight's low will be 70 degrees, and no rain is expected.

Regarding city news, road construction remains ongoing on Highway M west of Highway PB to facilitate improvements for the upcoming Aldi development. Additionally, the city is preparing for the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, which aims to improve accessibility with new bridges and paved surfaces starting later this year.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for Yoga at Insight Wellness on September 7 and trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee on September 8.

The Verona Police Department released a report stating that on Friday, September 4, a 34-year-old Madison woman was arrested for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member for incidents reported in 2019.
Culver's of Verona is featuring Chocolate Volcano as today's flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
